name: Cypress.io
description: GitHub Action for running Cypress end-to-end and component tests

auto-cancel-after-failures.description: Overrides the global Cloud configuration to set the failed test threshold for auto cancellation or to disable auto cancellation when recording to the Cloud (req

browser.description: Name of the browser to use

ci-build-id.description: ID associates multiple CI machines to one test run

component.description: Lets the action know that Cypress is running component tests and not e2e tests

config.description: Set configuration values. Separate multiple values with a comma. The values set here override any values set in your configuration file.

config-file.description: Path to the cypress config file where configuration values are set

headed.description: Whether or not to use headed mode

parallel.description: Whether or not to load balance recorded tests using multiple containers

quiet.description: Whether or not to silence any Cypress specific output from stdout

record.description: Sends test results to Cypress Cloud

build.description: Command to run build step before starting tests

command-prefix.description: You can prefix the default test command using the command-prefix option.

install.description: Whether or not to run install

publish-summary.description: Whether or not to publish a job summary

runTests.description: Whether or not to run tests

start.description: Command for starting local server in the background

start-windows.description: A different start command on Windows

wait-on.description: Local server URL to wait for

wait-on-timeout.description: Amount of time to wait for wait-on URL to be available
